problem:
Which of the following are elementary matrices?

$$
W=[\begin{aligned}1 & 0 \\ \frac{3}{4} & 1\end{aligned}],\,Y=[\begin{aligned}\frac{3}{4} & 0 \\ 2 & 1\end{aligned}],\,Z=[\begin{aligned}1 & 0 \\ -4 & 1\end{aligned}]
$$

examples.worked_solution:
An elementary matrix is a matrix obtained from the identity matrix by applying exactly one elementary row operation.

The given matrix $E$ is an elementary matrix because it can be obtained from $I_2$ by applying the elementary row operation $R_2:= R_2+(-5) R_1,$ as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}{I}_{2} & =[\begin{aligned}1 & 0 \\ 0 & 1\end{aligned}] & {R}_{2} & :={R}_{2}+(-5){R}_{1} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & 0 \\ -5 & 1\end{aligned}] \\  & =E\end{aligned}
$$
